wholePhysicalScope: Named native plant outline, native hall and tower footprints, approved public-domain street and across-river photography, and Ohio EPA architectural release-height records.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the three chimneys, twin hollow cooling towers and generating hall.
limitations: The two tall stacks use documented reference heights. Cooling-tower elevations, short stack height, steel framework and secondary hall geometry initially use photographic estimates.
Scope covers the above-ground plant silhouette and immediate exterior structures. Wider coal storage, switching yards and utilities are outside the model scope.
